card.title: PS4 WLOD and HDMI Encoder Faults

claims.statement: A faulty HDMI encoder IC is the most common cause of no display/WLOD.
claims.quote: HDMI Encoder Is faulty most of the time when there is no picture

claims.statement: If the HDMI encoder is replaced and the issue persists, the replacement IC may be faulty from the factory.
claims.quote: If you replaced encoder IC and still you get a WLOD replace encoder IC again it could be broken from factory.

procedure: Check hard drive health on a PC.
Inspect HDMI connector for physical damage.
Check HDMI filters and diodes near the HDMI circuit for continuity.
card.caveats: Diode measurements on the HDMI encoder often show no faults even when the IC is defective.
